pretreatments.description: Simultaneous saccharification and fermentation (SSF) of prehydrolysates and stillage residues for biomethane production
Chemical-thermal treatment of SCB using LHW (Lignin Hydrolysis Water), ethanol, 1% H2SO4, and 0.5% NaOH with or without PEG 6000 surfactant, conducted at 121°C for 60 min in a steam sterilizer
